title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: monitor agents (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, default agent policy, licensing statements and audit controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes the launched government-cloud roadmap item from Learn's preview documentation and keeps unpublished agent-specific details open.

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management is being expanded from users to agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is being expanded to agents

claims.claim: The roadmap describes indicators specific to agents.
claims.quote: with specific indicators and insider risk score built for agents based on agentic activities.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes an insider risk score built for agents based on agentic activities.
claims.quote: insider risk score built for agents based on agentic activities.

claims.claim: The roadmap says agents can access and manipulate enterprise data.
claims.quote: These agents can interpret intent, access and manipulate enterprise data, execute actions and even make real-time decisions.

claims.claim: The roadmap compares agents' operation to human insiders.
claims.quote: In many ways, they operate like human insiders only with machine-speed data processing capabilities.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn still describes the Risky Agents policy as preview, unlike the roadmap's General Availability phase.
claims.quote: The Risky Agents (preview) policy provides out-of-the-box coverage for common risk scenarios associated with AI agents.

claims.claim: The Learn agent pages do not explain the agent insider risk score itself or its calculation.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management agent risk score calculated baseline day Risky Agents GCC cloud'; read monitoring-agents, policy-templates, policies and agent-registry-overview. They describe detections, sharing risk and risk-signal counts, not the agent score's calculation.

claims.claim: Learn's Risky Agents documentation names no cloud.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management agent risk score calculated baseline day Risky Agents GCC cloud'; read monitoring-agents in full and Risky Agents sections of policy-templates and policies. No cloud is named in those agent descriptions.

claims.claim: The agent monitoring page gives no separate cloud-specific rollout details.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management agent risk score calculated baseline day Risky Agents GCC cloud'; opened monitoring-agents in full. It states default availability with supported licences, without cloud-specific rollout details.

claims.claim: Administrative units are not supported for agent alerts.
claims.quote: Admins units are currently not supported for agent alerts.

claims.claim: A scoped analyst cannot see agent alerts.
claims.quote: If a scoped analyst is signing in, then they can't see agent related alerts.

claims.claim: Unscoped users with alert-investigation permissions can see agent alerts.
claims.quote: Members who aren't assigned administrative units are unrestricted administrators and have access to all settings, policies, and user data. Access & investigate alerts: Yes for Insider Risk Management, Analysts and Investigators.

claims.claim: Analysts investigating agent alerts can review details of detected activity.
claims.quote: Through alert investigation, analysts can: Review details of the detected activity. Understand the context of agent behavior. Determine whether further action is required.

claims.claim: Full prompt and response content is unavailable for investigating guest interactions with agents.
claims.quote: When guest users are interacting with agents, the full prompt and response content isn't available for investigation.

claims.claim: Only sensitive-information indicators from guest prompts and responses are shown.
claims.quote: Instead, only indicators of sensitive information detected in those prompts and responses are shown.

claims.claim: Global Administrator alone is insufficient to open IRM alerts through agent-registry risk details.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview — IRM alerts | IRM Analyst or IRM Investigator. Global Administrator alone is insufficient; a Global Administrator can assign themselves the additional IRM role.

claims.claim: The agent registry lists IRM Analyst or IRM Investigator as the required role for the IRM alert deep link.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview — IRM alerts | IRM Analyst or IRM Investigator.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; controls[0].note
claims.claim: Learn offers a custom Insider Risk Management policy when the default agent policy does not meet requirements.
claims.quote: If the default policy doesn't meet your organizational requirements, you can create a custom Insider Risk Management policy to better align with your risk posture or investigation needs.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Insider Risk Management > Policies > Agent policy reaches the agent-policy dashboard.
claims.quote: Go to the Insider Risk Management solution. Select Policies in the left navigation. ... Your policies are separated into two categories: User policy and Agent policy. Switch between the two to locate relevant policy details.
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path to 'Insider Risk Management > Policies > Agent policy > policy' to reach policy details, as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/insider-risk-management-policies. Keep the note that the administrator selects the policy to see its details.

claims.claim: No API for managing Insider Risk Management agent policies is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management Risky Agents policy turn off disable scope agents PowerShell API Set insider risk policy'; 'site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Insider Risk Management policies API agent policy manage'. Read policies and monitoring-agents; no IRM policy API found.

claims.claim: The Policies dashboard separates user and agent policies into User policy and Agent policy views.
claims.quote: Your policies are separated into two categories: User policy and Agent policy. Switch between the two to locate relevant policy details.

claims.claim: The Agent policy dashboard covers Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry agents.
claims.quote: Agent policy covers agents from Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Audit > Start recording user and admin activity enables auditing.
claims.quote: Select the Audit solution card. ... If auditing isn't turned on for your organization, a banner is displayed ... Select the Start recording user and admin activity banner.

claims.claim: Set-AdminAuditLogConfig -UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled $true enables auditing in Exchange Online PowerShell.
claims.quote: Connect to Exchange Online PowerShell. Run the following PowerShell command to turn on auditing. Set-AdminAuditLogConfig -UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled $true

claims.claim: Turning auditing on or off requires the Audit Logs role in Exchange Online.
claims.quote: You must be assigned the Audit Logs role in Exchange Online to turn auditing on or off.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 audit log is an Insider Risk Management prerequisite used by its policies.
claims.quote: Step 2 (required): Enable the Microsoft 365 audit log. Insider Risk Management uses Microsoft 365 audit logs for user insights and risk management activities identified in policies and analytics insights.

claims.claim: Auditing is on by default for Microsoft 365 organisations, subject to the stated exceptions.
claims.quote: Audit logging is on by default for Microsoft 365 organizations.

claims.claim: Auditing is not enabled by default for Microsoft 365 Business Basic, Business Standard and Business Premium.
claims.quote: Auditing isn't enabled by default for Small and Medium Business (SMB) licenses, including Microsoft 365 Business Basic, Business Standard, and Business Premium.

claims.claim: Unmanaged tenants using free enterprise licence trials do not have auditing enabled by default.
claims.quote: Additionally, unmanaged tenants that use free trials of enterprise licenses don't have auditing enabled by default.

claims.claim: Accessing and configuring recommended actions requires the Insider Risk Management or Insider Risk Management Admins role group.
claims.quote: To access and configure recommended actions, users must be assigned to the Insider Risk Management or Insider Risk Management Admins role groups.

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management role groups determine who can configure policies.
claims.quote: Configure policies and settings | Yes | Yes | No | No | No | No

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management role groups determine who can investigate alerts.
claims.quote: Access & investigate alerts | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No | No

claims.claim: Insider Risk Management role-group memberships are managed on the Microsoft Purview portal's Role groups page.
claims.quote: The easiest way to assign roles is to add the user to the appropriate role group on the Role groups page in the Microsoft Purview portal.

claims.claim: Learn does not document a setting or API specifically for turning off the default Risky Agents policy.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management Risky Agents policy turn off disable scope agents PowerShell API Set insider risk policy'; read monitoring-agents and policies in full. General policy deletion is documented; no default Risky Agents off setting or API is stated.

claims.claim: Learn does not document a setting or API specifically for scoping the default Risky Agents policy to particular agents.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management Risky Agents policy turn off disable scope agents PowerShell API Set insider risk policy'; read monitoring-agents and policies. Custom policies and user scoping are described; default Risky Agents scoping to particular agents is not.

claims.claim: The agent monitoring page describes investigation rather than documenting an agent block or remediation operation.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Insider Risk Management Risky Agents policy turn off disable scope agents PowerShell API Set insider risk policy'; read monitoring-agents in full. It documents detections, alert investigation, custom policies and sharing risk, not an agent block or remediation operation.

claims.claim: The sources describe no ordinary-user or agent-user experience change caused by this monitoring capability.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management monitoring agents Risky Agents policy licensing audit policy'; read roadmap record, monitoring-agents and Risky Agents template. They describe monitoring and analyst investigation, not a change in users' interaction experience.

claims.claim: Learn documents no API for managing Insider Risk Management policies.
claims.quote: Searched: 'site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Insider Risk Management policies API agent policy manage'; 'Insider Risk Management Risky Agents policy turn off disable scope agents PowerShell API Set insider risk policy'. Read policies; no IRM policy-management API found.

claims.claim: Before monitoring agents, organisations must complete Get started with Insider Risk Management.
claims.quote: Before you begin monitoring agents in your organization, you must complete the steps provided in Get started with Insider Risk Management.

claims.claim: The agent monitoring page directs licensing questions to the general Insider Risk Management subscriptions and licensing section.
claims.quote: For information about subscriptions, licensing, and permissions, see Subscriptions and licensing and Permissions in Insider Risk Management.
